mechanism_evidence.trigger: Load real INI sections with root keys, interpolation and a valueless option.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The loader changes section flattening/case, disables expected no-value/interpolation behavior and returns None.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Decode original INI namespaces and interpolation into lowercase flattened keys, preserving root sections and fluent return.

discriminating_observation.description:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from bottle import ConfigDict
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
 p=Path(folder)/'data.ini';p.write_text('[bottle]\nBase = red\n[Theme]\nColor = ${bottle:base}\nEmpty\n')
 c=ConfigDict();r=c.load_config(str(p));print('ini_values',dict(c))
 assert r is c and c['base']=='red' and c['theme.color']=='red' and c['theme.empty'] is None

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Load a nested mapping with a namespace and non-string leaf values.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The loader checks value type instead of key type, drops recursive namespaces and stores the wrong channel.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Validate string keys and recursively carry the joined namespace while retaining leaf values.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import ConfigDict
c=ConfigDict();r=c.load_dict({'db':{'port':5432,'name':'main'}},namespace='service')
print('flattened_config',dict(c))
assert r is c and dict(c)=={'service.db.port':5432,'service.db.name':'main'}

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Update a plain key and a namespaced key whose namespace has surrounding dots.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite invents a default prefix and appends two separators for namespaced updates.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Preserve empty prefixes and normalize one separator between namespace and key.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import ConfigDict
c=ConfigDict();c.update(root=1);c.update('.service.',port=2)
print('namespace_update',dict(c))
assert dict(c)=={'root':1,'service.port':2}

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Keep one overlay alive and collect a second one.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The callback filters in dead weak references and filters out living overlays.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Dereference overlays and yield only live owners.

discriminating_observation.description:
import gc
from bottle import ConfigDict
base=ConfigDict();live=base._make_overlay();dead=base._make_overlay();del dead;gc.collect();value=list(base._iter_overlays())
print('live_overlay_owners',len(value))
assert value==[live]

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Delete a root-owned setting inherited by two overlay levels.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The function swaps notification arguments and recursively calls itself instead of the child overlay.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Deliver the same deletion key to each child and preserve the key/value notification contract.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import ConfigDict
base=ConfigDict();base['x']=1;a=base._make_overlay();b=a._make_overlay();events=[];b._add_change_listener(lambda cfg,key,value:events.append((key,value)))
del base['x'];print('deleted_virtual_tree',dict(base),dict(a),dict(b),events)
assert 'x' not in a and 'x' not in b and events==[('x',None)]

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Set a filter through shared metadata and update the actual configuration value.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: Key and metadata-field coordinates are transposed, so the consumer misses its filter.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Store the metadata value under the requested configuration key and field.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import ConfigDict
c=ConfigDict();c.meta_set('port','filter',int);c['port']='5432';child=c._make_overlay()
print('filtered_config',c['port'],child.meta_get('port','filter'))
assert c['port']==5432 and child.meta_get('port','filter') is int

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Close an application containing a plugin with a close method.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The close loop recursively calls application.close instead of the plugin method.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Delegate closure to each installed plugin resource.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import Bottle
class Plugin:
 def __init__(self):self.closed=0
 def close(self):self.closed+=1
app=Bottle();p=Plugin();app.plugins[:]=[p];app.close();print('plugin_closed',p.closed)
assert p.closed==1

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Uninstall one resource-bearing plugin by identity while another remains installed.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite removes plugins but omits their close callbacks.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Close removed plugins and retain the remaining plugin lifecycle.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import Bottle
class Plugin:
 def __init__(self):self.closed=0
 def close(self):self.closed+=1
app=Bottle();p=Plugin();q=Plugin();app.plugins[:]=[p,q];removed=app.uninstall(p);print('uninstall_lifecycle',p.closed,q.closed,len(app.plugins))
assert removed==[p] and p.closed==1 and q.closed==0 and app.plugins==[q]

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Install a valid plugin whose setup inspects current registry visibility.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite publishes the plugin before calling setup.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Run setup before appending the plugin, preserving the installation event order.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import Bottle
class Plugin:
 def setup(self,app):
  self.seen_before_publication=self not in app.plugins
 def apply(self,callback,route):return callback
app=Bottle();p=Plugin();r=app.install(p);print('setup_publication_order',p.seen_before_publication)
assert r is p and p.seen_before_publication and p in app.plugins

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Register two before-request and two after-request hooks, then trigger them.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite reverses normal registration and inserts the application instead of after-hook callbacks.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Store callbacks in FIFO order for before hooks and LIFO order for after hooks.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import Bottle
app=Bottle();seen=[]
app.add_hook('before_request',lambda:seen.append('b1'));app.add_hook('before_request',lambda:seen.append('b2'))
app.add_hook('after_request',lambda:seen.append('a1'));app.add_hook('after_request',lambda:seen.append('a2'))
app.trigger_hook('before_request');app.trigger_hook('after_request');print('hook_event_order',seen)
assert seen==['b1','b2','a2','a1']

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Trigger a configuration hook with positional and keyword arguments.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite supplies the args tuple and kwargs dictionary as two positional values, and reverses callback traversal.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Forward positional and keyword arguments to callbacks in the registered order.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import Bottle
app=Bottle();seen=[]
app.add_hook('config',lambda key,value=None:seen.append(('first',key,value)))
app.add_hook('config',lambda key,value=None:seen.append(('second',key,value)))
app.trigger_hook('config','port',value=3);print('hook_forwarded_arguments',seen)
assert seen==[('first','port',3),('second','port',3)]

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Enter and normally exit an application context.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite invokes an invalid insert operation instead of popping the context on normal exit.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Pop the pushed application for both normal and exceptional exits.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import Bottle,default_app
app=Bottle();old=list(default_app)
with app:
 assert default_app() is app
print('released_app_context',len(default_app),len(old))
assert list(default_app)==old

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Resolve a route-local plugin with the same name as a global plugin.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite yields both entries and changes application precedence/skip handling.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Traverse route/application plugins in original reverse priority and deduplicate by name.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import Bottle,Route
class Plugin:
 name='same'
app=Bottle();global_p=Plugin();local_p=Plugin();app.plugins[:]=[global_p]
route=Route(app,'/','GET',lambda:'ok',plugins=[local_p]);value=list(route.all_plugins());print('effective_plugin_count',len(value))
assert value==[local_p]

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Compile a route callback, reset it, then invoke it again.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite clears all route attributes instead of removing only its cached call.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Invalidate the compiled callback while preserving route identity/configuration needed to rebuild it.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import Bottle,Route
app=Bottle();callback=lambda:'ok';r=Route(app,'/x','GET',callback);assert r.call()=='ok';r.reset()
print('route_cache_reset',r.app is app,r.callback is callback)
assert r.app is app and r.callback is callback and r.call()=='ok'

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Inspect a closure-decorated callback without a __wrapped__ attribute.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite follows Python2 func_closure and misses actual Python3 __closure__ cells.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Recover the real function from the current Python closure protocol.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import Bottle,Route
def original(x):return x
def decorate(fn):
 def wrapped(*args,**kwargs):return fn(*args,**kwargs)
 return wrapped
r=Route(Bottle(),'/','GET',decorate(original));value=r.get_undecorated_callback();print('closure_callback_recovered',value is original)
assert value is original

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Read named callback arguments from the introspection result.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The wrapper returns the varargs channel instead of the list of named arguments.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Select the named-argument component from the existing getargspec result; the introspection algorithm is unchanged.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import Bottle,Route
def callback(first,second=2):return first
r=Route(Bottle(),'/','GET',callback);value=r.get_callback_args();print('named_callback_args',value)
assert value==['first','second']

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Compile a plugin declaring API1 whose apply method consumes route configuration.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite changes the apply context from Route to the raw callback for API1 plugins.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Forward the actual Route context to the existing plugin apply contract.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import Bottle,Route
class Plugin:
 api=1
 def apply(self,callback,context):
  assert isinstance(context,Route)
  self.seen=context.config['token'];return callback
app=Bottle();app.plugins[:]=[];p=Plugin();r=Route(app,'/','GET',lambda:'ok',plugins=[p],token='route-value');value=r.call()
print('plugin_route_context',value,p.seen)
assert value=='ok' and p.seen=='route-value'

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Iterate a byte stream whose length crosses multiple wrapper chunk boundaries.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite reads uneven chunk sizes and drops each yielded final byte.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Partition the stream into consistent bounded chunks without dropping byte positions.

discriminating_observation.description:
import io
from bottle import WSGIFileWrapper
value=list(WSGIFileWrapper(io.BytesIO(b'abcdefghij'),buffer_size=4));print('wsgi_file_chunks',value)
assert value==[b'abcd',b'efgh',b'ij'] and b''.join(value)==b'abcdefghij'

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Save an uploaded file onto an existing destination with default overwrite=False.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite silently overwrites the existing path; its chunk_size+1 change alone need not change file contents.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Retain the existing-file boundary and raise before replacing destination bytes.

discriminating_observation.description:
import io,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from bottle import FileUpload
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
 p=Path(folder)/'saved.txt';p.write_bytes(b'keep');upload=FileUpload(io.BytesIO(b'new'),'file','name.txt')
 try:
  upload.save(str(p))
 except IOError:
  print('existing_destination_preserved',p.read_bytes());assert p.read_bytes()==b'keep'
 else:
  raise AssertionError('existing file overwritten without explicit request')

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Read request body twice through its public property.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The property rewinds to byte1 instead of byte0, dropping content on every access.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Restore the stream position before each new consumer reads the cached body.

discriminating_observation.description:
import io
from bottle import BaseRequest
r=BaseRequest({'wsgi.input':io.BytesIO(b'abc'),'CONTENT_LENGTH':'3'});first=r.body.read();second=r.body.read()
print('reusable_request_stream',first,second)
assert first==second==b'abc'

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Decode a repeated query key and a second named value.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite swaps keys and values, reverses insertion order and returns None.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Build and return the ordered multivalue query representation with its original channels.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import BaseRequest
r=BaseRequest({'QUERY_STRING':'tag=one&tag=two&name=alice'});value=r.query
print('query_multivalue',value.getall('tag'),value['name'])
assert value.getall('tag')==['one','two'] and value['tag']=='two' and value['name']=='alice'

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Merge repeated query and form values using actual request body parsing.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite puts form values before query values and returns None.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Append form values after query values and return the complete combined multivalue representation.

discriminating_observation.description:
import io
from bottle import BaseRequest
r=BaseRequest({'QUERY_STRING':'x=query','REQUEST_METHOD':'POST','CONTENT_TYPE':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded','CONTENT_LENGTH':'6','wsgi.input':io.BytesIO(b'x=form')})
value=r.params;print('merged_request_params',value.getall('x'))
assert value.getall('x')==['query','form'] and value['x']=='form'

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Copy a response with multi-value headers and cookie attributes, then change the copy.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite changes header keys and cookie values and discards the returned response.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Return an independent response copy with original header/cookie value and metadata semantics.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import BaseResponse
r=BaseResponse();r.add_header('X-Value','one');r.set_cookie('session','token',path='/app');c=r.copy()
assert c is not None and c is not r
c.add_header('X-Value','two');c.set_cookie('session','changed',path='/app')
print('response_copy_ownership',r.get_header('X-Value'),c.get_header('X-Value'))
assert r.get_header('X-Value')=='one' and c.get_header('X-Value')=='two' and r._cookies['session'].value=='token' and r._cookies['session']['path']=='/app'

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Register two relative resource directories and prepend the second after caching a lookup.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite bypasses path normalization and changes insertion-index semantics. Cache clearing itself is unchanged.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Normalize paths relative to the configured base and honor the requested insertion priority before consumers resolve resources.

discriminating_observation.description:
import os,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from bottle import ResourceManager
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
 root=Path(folder);(root/'a').mkdir();(root/'b').mkdir();(root/'a'/'x').write_text('A');(root/'b'/'x').write_text('B')
 r=ResourceManager(base=str(root/'anchor.py'));assert r.add_path('a/');first=r.lookup('x');assert r.add_path('b/',index=0);second=r.lookup('x')
 print('resource_priority',first,second);assert first==str(root/'a'/'x') and second==str(root/'b'/'x')

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Apply a string template configuration to a callback returning view data.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The string branch returns the raw callback and bypasses the view renderer.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Route template configuration through the actual view wrapper and template consumer.

discriminating_observation.description:
from bottle import Bottle,Route,TemplatePlugin
r=Route(Bottle(),'/','GET',lambda:{'name':'Ada'},template='Hello {{name}}');wrapped=TemplatePlugin().apply(r.callback,r);value=wrapped()
print('template_config_consumed',value)
assert value=='Hello Ada'
